review_type: Independent read-only source review; no edits or compilation
compile_status: Targeted exit0 reported by author/root; full log inspected, extract/deterministic print only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound
completeness_checks: Strong induction is on actual Request.fuel, uniformly over all five Request constructors; no successful-outcome, termination or gas premise is supplied.
X fuel0 is its OutOfFuel certificate. Positive X splits actual Z. Z error ends without a step; accepted Z extracts actual step certificate at one less fuel before inspecting the step result.

If step errors, xStepError retains that child tree. If step succeeds, actual H selects halt/revert or continued X at one less fuel. Continuation and step may share numeric fuel but are distinct tree edges and each is smaller than parent X.

Positive Xi extracts exact fresh X at fuel-1. Positive Theta separates precompiled/no-Xi from Code/actual Xi at fuel-1. Positive Lambda separates failed preimage/no-init from actual selected init Xi at fuel-1, preserving child tree regardless of outer settlement.

Step selection always inspects selectedChild; none produces done, some obtains the exact selected Request certificate using stepChild_fuel. This includes child fuel0 and all child outcomes. No result-dependent erasure of selected children.
Exported extract quantifies every Request and certifies that same q.eval; it does not return an assumed event count or postcondition.
determinism_checks: Induction on the first Cert eliminates constructor conflicts using literal Z result equality, actual child outcome_deterministic, H none/some conflicts and REVERT/not-REVERT contradictions.

Matching accepted-Z branches first identify identical mid and cost; dependent StepArgs.guard proof differences are safely irrelevant. Successful-step branches then identify actual post states before applying continuation induction.
Matched halt/revert branches need only child tree equality; output equality is not assumed to establish tree equality because outputs do not determine tree shape.
Theta Code versus Precompiled and Lambda Some versus None conflicts are eliminated by discriminator equality. Matching bytes/preimages are identified before child induction.
Step None versus Some and matching selected child identities use stepChild_unique. Matching wrappers preserve exactly the child tree; no extra event or duplicate subtree is inserted.
deterministic covers certificates with arbitrary outcomes r1/r2 for the same request; outcome equality is derived via prior sound theorem where branch discrimination needs it.
limits: The resulting unique tree is a complete nested certificate for the reviewed selectedChild/pinned evaluator definition; correctness of selected-child semantics relies on the separately reviewed Args equations and exact pinned evaluator dispatch.

This does not itself prove event-to-append injection, XiAt frame-root grammar, distinct successful call occurrence ownership, aggregate gas/debit theorem, transaction/block accounting or protocol reachability.
Local markers remain the conservative completed LOG0 length>=68 superset, not a claim that every marker is an EIP8282 append.
The theorem gives finite-fuel all-outcome extraction, not unlimited evaluation termination, user-call liveness or fork-semantic correspondence.
conclusion: Completeness and complete-tree determinism are sound for all actual finite-fuel Request outcomes. No blocking finding. Frozen Args/Cert compile receipts are now attached to their prior review.
